name: kickpro
description: KickPro — Platform Otomasi Event Mabar, Kas Komunitas & Hub Sparring Sepak Bola / Mini Soccer / Futsal

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kickpro/shared build && pnpm --filter @kickpro/functions build && pnpm --filter @kickpro/web build
scripts.dev:all: pnpm --filter @kickpro/shared build && concurrently -n emulators,web -c cyan,green "pnpm emulators" "pnpm --filter @kickpro/web dev"
scripts.test:rules:ci: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-kickpro --only firestore "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
